slides.texte_overlay:
5 easy habits that make
your mind feel lighter

a slow morning drink

drink your first coffee or tea slowly, sitting down, with no phone. starting the day calmly instead of in a rush changes how heavy the rest of it feels.

a short worry list

write your worries on paper once a day and close the notebook. putting them somewhere outside your head makes them feel smaller and much easier to carry.

a gentle lesson

spend 5 minutes a day learning something beautiful and new: a constellation, a painting, a myth. gentle curiosity gives a busy mind somewhere peaceful to rest.
slides.texte_sophia:
a gentle lesson

i spend 5 minutes a day learning something beautiful: a constellation, a painting, a myth. i do it with the Sophia app, one lesson a day, and my busy mind has somewhere peaceful to rest.

slides.texte_overlay:
fresh air

open a window or step outside for a moment every few hours. fresh air and natural light are some of the simplest and most reliable ways to quickly lift your mood.

an early night

go to bed thirty minutes earlier once or twice a week. a rested mind handles stress far better, and most problems look so much smaller in the morning light.
